workload: 8 fixed random BGRA 64x16 tiles; 1000 encodes per sample; 9 alternating-order samples; 2 warmup rounds
method: Build HEAD wht.c as before and candidate wht.c as after; ctypes harness alternates library order by round, warms both, asserts exact output equality, and reports per-call wall-clock medians.
limits: Single host and SDK; medians are directional evidence, not a cross-machine guarantee.
